description: Figure 3 presents the distribution of samples across different subtasks within the MMRA benchmark. The chart is a pie chart comprised of six slices, each representing a subtask. The “NearSceneEntity” subtask is colored light green and accounts for approximately 28.2% of the total samples, with 30 samples shown. “LocatedNear” is colored light blue and represents 18.3% (19 samples). “TemporalRelation” is colored orange and comprises 16.7% (17 samples). “SceneChange” is colored yellow and accounts for 15.1% (16 samples). “DropSample” is colored red and represents 12.8% (13 samples). Finally, “OutdoorScenes” is colored dark green and accounts for 8.9% (9 samples). The chart includes a legend identifying each subtask and its corresponding color, and each slice is labeled with both the number of samples and the percentage it represents. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
